RealProperty.Name: prop_AveragePayload
RealProperty.Description: Average payload weight in kg when loaded

BooleanState.Name: var_Loaded
BooleanState.Description: True when truck is loaded with payload, False when empty

BooleanState.Name: var_SpeedUpdates
BooleanState.Description: Flag to enable/disable speed physics updates (default True)

Event.Name: event_SpeedUpdates_True
Event.Description: Fired when speed updates are enabled (sets `var_SpeedUpdates = True`)

Event.Name: event_SpeedUpdates_False
Event.Description: Fired when speed updates are disabled (sets `var_SpeedUpdates = False`)

Event.Name: event_Loaded_True
Event.Description: Fired when truck becomes loaded (sets `var_Loaded = True`, raises tray symbol)

Event.Name: event_Loaded_False
Event.Description: Fired when truck becomes empty (sets `var_Loaded = False`, lowers tray symbol)

Event.Name: event_OnRunInitialised
Event.Description: Fired at simulation start to initialize truck and create/assign battery

Event.Name: event_OnRunEnding
Event.Description: Fired at simulation end for cleanup and final statistics

Event.Name: event_SymbolUpdate_RaiseTray
Event.Description: Fired to raise truck tray (during loading or battery swap)

Event.Name: event_SymbolUpdate_LowerTray
Event.Description: Fired to lower truck tray (after unloading or battery swap)

ElementReferenceState.Name: var_BatteryEntityInstance
ElementReferenceState.Description: Reference to created battery entity instance
